high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from medium.com, displaying an article about the communication of signals between neurons. The text explains the process of synaptic transmission, detailing how electrical signals from a presynaptic neuron's axon reach the postsynaptic neuron through neurotransmitters released by vesicles across the synaptic cleft. It mentions that some synapses are excitatory, increasing the likelihood of the postsynaptic neuron generating its own signal, while others are inhibitory, decreasing this likelihood. The strength of the influence varies among synapses.
